sources.title: HyperCLOVA X SEED | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: HyperCLOVA X SEED is NAVER's lightweight, open-source line of models (0.5B, 1.5B, 3B parameters) aimed at commercial use. The "SEED Think 14B" version adds deeper reasoning, pruning/distillation, and advanced training so it can compete with much larger models while being more efficient.

sources.snippet: HyperCLOVA X SEED Think is NAVER Cloud's language model combining pruning and knowledge distillation with advanced reasoning capabilities. The 14B model features a Transformer-based architecture with Peri-Layer Normalization and Maximal Update Parameterization (μP), 14.74B parameters, and 32k context length. It supports dual-mode reasoning (think / non-think) and function calling via a ChatML ...

sources.title: HyperCLOVA X | CLOVA
sources.snippet: HyperCLOVA X SEED 8B Omni is a Korean-centered any-to-any model that processes and generates text, images, and audio through a unified architecture. Built on deep Korean-language understanding, it seamlessly handles explanations, conversations, visual analysis, and voice interactions within integrated reasoning workflows.
